description.zh:
是否查询静默策略详情。

- `true`：查询。
- `false`：不查询。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query the details of a silence policy. Valid values:

*   `true`: Details of the silence policy are queried.
*   `false`: Details about notification policies are not queried.
The name of the silence policy.
The number of the page to return.
The number of entries to return on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-silence-policies --name silencepolicy_test --page 1 --size 20 --is-detail true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListSilencePolicies --region cn-hangzhou --Size 20 --Page 1 --IsDetail true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name silencepolicy_test
